description:
Welcome to Home Safe After 60 - practical home safety and security tips for women over 60, especially those living alone.

Discover affordable home defense tips , burglary prevention strategies, nightime safety routines, sacm awareness, and simple ways to protect your home and stay prepared for emergencies.

Stay safe, confident, and independent after 60.

Subscribe for practical safety advice designed for women living alone.
